decisions.decision: Bundle openGym domain logic as an ES2019 IIFE via esbuild 0.28.2 with String.prototype.replaceAll polyfill for QuickJS
decisions.rationale: QuickJS in flutter_js doesn't support ESM or replaceAll natively; IIFE attached to globalThis.__openGymLib provides clean synchronous access

decisions.decision: Runtime-level safe IIFE call envelope in JsEngineService: try { return JSON.stringify({ok: ...}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({e: ...}); }
decisions.rationale: JavaScriptCore in flutter_js detects errors via string prefix 'ERROR:' which causes false positives; structured JSON envelope guarantees 100% reliable error capture

decisions.decision: Use jsUndefined sentinel object mapping to void 0 in JS calls
decisions.rationale: Allows passing undefined for optional parameters without losing default argument values in JS functions

decisions.decision: Base64 gzip/chunked fixture embedding into tool/parity/parity_fixtures_data.dart
decisions.rationale: Bypasses Flutter asset bundle requirement for parity harness execution, allowing fast, isolated testing
